decision.observation: Ellis (cap) and Coach are coming toward me in single file along the narrow balcony, with the wall on the left and the railing on the right.
decision.hypothesis: The bots want to pass toward the balcony end. Backing up further should give them room, or they will stop and let me squeeze past.

Inventory: crowbar (slot 2), pipe bomb (slot 3), medkit (slot 4). Unexplored: the open room left of the fire/EXIT corridor, door 801, and a possible down flight in the stairwell.
